epics.name: Store readiness & release train
epics.goal: Ship the Pro build to the Chrome Web Store, then make every release a repeatable, staged, reversible train with generated notes.

epics.name: Real-DOM fixture harness & regression suite
epics.goal: Captured, scrubbed tenant pages become CI fixtures that assert the mapping, the apply, the required audit and the no-submit rule; production fill rates raise an alert when an ATS changes.

epics.name: ATS coverage
epics.goal: Dedicated adapters for every host we already claim (iCIMS, SmartRecruiters, Taleo, BambooHR, Jobvite), depth on the thin ones, and the next ATS families — each with fixtures, never from guessed markup.

epics.name: Fill engine quality
epics.goal: Generic multi-step orchestration, reliable combos, custom required widgets, a post-fill report and a performance budget — the engine handles the long tail without silent misses.

epics.name: Capture, submit detection & tracker write-through
epics.goal: Submission detection with per-ATS signals and a measured precision, resolved in the drawer, plus JD snapshots and events so the tracker fills itself honestly.

epics.name: Drawer & on-page experience
epics.goal: The drawer tells the user what it found and what needs them, badges boards, asks for a review once, and hands off to tailoring in one tap.

epics.name: In-page AI assist
epics.goal: Grounded drafts for free-text questions, option-validated picks and the field mapper, on by default for Pro with explicit consent, capped and cached.

epics.name: Autopilot orchestrator (Phase 19)
epics.goal: Batch-prepare applications in the user's own browser window, park what needs them, ask and remember answers, and stop before submit, every time.

epics.name: Telemetry, errors & remote config
epics.goal: Count-only engine telemetry v2, product events through one seam, error fingerprints, and a read-only remote config that can pause an ATS or require an update without a release.

epics.name: Cross-browser: Firefox, Edge, Safari
epics.goal: Firefox live-verified and listed on AMO, Edge listed, Safari evaluated — one release train, one artifact per browser.

epics.name: Security, privacy & trust proofs
epics.goal: A test that proves we never click submit, CI that proves the privacy disclosure matches the manifest, detectors that stop at CAPTCHAs, and a panel that shows what the extension sends.

epics.name: Organization & marketer hooks
epics.goal: The marketer's drawer action and the assignment status flow from submit-detect, consent-scoped and never submitting.

epics.name: Web ↔ extension hand-off & install funnel
epics.goal: Connect that never dead-ends, extension-aware web cards, a try-it page that proves the fill in 30 seconds, and an install/uninstall funnel we can measure.
